At cd48fc14e the defect VT13 named is repaired: production-field-map.json exists at the family root and is substantive, product-wiring.json binds it, and the fixtures were rebuilt with it — VT13 measured canonical.pdf at f46c9e87... and 8088 bytes, and it is now ddf3d484... at 8279 bytes. ohioPriorVerdict.butTheVerdictStands: FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED, on five obligations and on grounds no lane has recorded: an absent companion PDF the participant is twice told ships, a fee statement that contradicts the packet's own second instruction file and the track registry, a service statement that denies holding what the registry holds, four of five registry-declared components undelivered, and six of nine registry stop conditions absent. newYorkDuplication.question: The NY court transmission letter ships from two families. Establish what this family delivers, whether the two outputs are the same document, and whether the duplication is a defect or a shared component correctly used twice.
newYorkDuplication.whatThisFamilyDelivers: One assembled 4-page packet: pages 1-2 the letter to the clerk of the sentencing court asking it to transmit or correct the § 160.55 sealing notice, with four labelled matter items C1-C4; pages 3-4 the process guidance. Both pages foot this family's own route key.
newYorkDuplication.sameDocumentEvidence: Extracted both from their own committed bytes and compared. Different titles ('...A CPL Sec. 160.55 SEALING NOTICE' against '...THE SEALING NOTICE'), different addressee (the clerk of the court that sentenced you, against THE RECORDS OFFICE OF THE COURT THAT DISPOSED OF THE CASE), entirely different field structure (four bracket items C1-C4 against six captioned certificate-of-disposition lines and four numbered paragraphs), no shared paragraph, different route footers, and even different canonical personas (42 Magnolia Street, Springfield 62704 against 42 Larkspur Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201). Different page counts for the packets as a whole: 4 against 6.
newYorkDuplication.sharedComponentEvidence: Two separate build scripts with no shared composing code: scripts/build-census-v1-composed-treatment:...:sentencing_court_transmission_correction_request.mjs at 1102 lines and scripts/build-census-v1-agency-application-treatment:...:dcjs_correction_submission.mjs at 1817 lines. They share only generic PDF helpers.
newYorkDuplication.soTheAnswerIsNeither: It is not a shared component correctly used twice, and it is not the same document duplicated. It is the same participant-facing step drafted twice, independently, in different words.
newYorkDuplication.isItADefectAndWhose: Not a defect of this family, and this family's PASS does not rest on it. The census records two distinct A_MUST_FULFILL routes with different destinations and different instruments, and this family delivers exactly its own route's instrument, naming the DCJS submission as the workflow's next step without supplying that route's letter. The exposure sits on the DCJS family, which declares routeKeys of only [obligation:research-decision-route:NY:ny_160_55_violation:dcjs_correction_submission] yet ships court_transmission_correction_request — the census's instrument for a DIFFERENT route — as its own packet component on its pages 1-2. A participant on both routes would receive two differently worded letters to the same court asking for the same thing.
newYorkDuplication.whatIDidNotDo: The DCJS family is not this lane's claim. I read its committed records and extracted its delivered text read-only to answer the question, opened nothing else, and changed nothing. It is recorded below as a finding for whichever lane holds it.
